reviews.comment: Mark is a good and caring professor who possesses extensive knowledge in his field. His class requires a lot of reading and is solely set up on group discussions, which was not my preferred way of learning,g but he is passionate about it. I would recommend him, but probably for a different class topic because 460 was very history-heavy.
Amazing professor!!! Really funny and his lectures are thoughtful and entertaining.

Best professor I have had an TAMU by a mile! He is so engaging and always makes class entertaining. 460 does a lot of deep dives into culture wars, and he is so passionate about it so it makes the class exciting. He does assign a lot of readings but they are all interesting. He is just so smart and you leave every class feeling smarter as well.
